github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Generate commit messages using the Conventional Commits format: type(scope): description.
Use one of these types when appropriate: feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore, style, perf, build, or ci.
Use an optional lowercase scope that identifies the affected area, such as chatbot, rag, agents, docs, or deps.
Write the subject in the imperative mood, using lowercase after the colon. Prefer concise, specific wording and keep the subject at 72 characters or fewer.
Do not end the subject with a period, do not use vague wording, and do not include emojis.
Add a body only when the change needs context. Leave one blank line after the subject, explain what changed and why, and wrap body lines at 72 characters.
Return only the commit message, with no quotation marks, labels, explanations, or Markdown code fences.
